author: Epic Games
description:
Bus Simulator 27 is now available on Epic Games Store: https://epic.gm/bussimulator-27 

Build your own bus company and drive more than 45 officially licensed buses from 13 world-famous manufacturers, such as Solaris™️, Mercedes-Benz, MAN, IVECO BUS, Scania, and Volvo. 

Felicia Bay is the perfect place to work where others go on vacation – a sunny fictive region in Southern Europe inspired by Spain and Portugal. Explore the vibrant twin cities of Alcaztelar and Mequina, featuring 20 unique districts packed with exciting landmarks – all brought to life by dynamic weather, a full day and night cycle, and bustling, crowded streets powered by Unreal®️ Engine 5.  

Create and serve routes, manage timetables, hire bus drivers, assign lines, customize buses with wraps and advertisements, and restore faith in public transportation in the local residents and visiting tourists.  

Jump aboard and Ride the Sunshine!
